intent: Build a voice-driven control layer for macOS where Jev is the universal fallback rather than the router. The immediate goal is the Rust port of the proven Python accessibility driver, at parity, so that nothing downstream rests on code that cannot be verified. Emma, the voice front end, follows on top once the observation and execution layers are trustworthy.

decisions: Jev is the FALLBACK, not the primary. Most requests are queries answered in ~50ms from structured data; Jev exists for the long tail with no direct path.
v0.1 is Group A only - voice to answer about projects. No Jev, no AX permission, no Rust port required.
The ten invariants R1-R10 stand as written, each carrying the measurement that justifies it.
UI is Tauri, not SwiftUI. Liquid Glass needs Xcode 26; this machine has SDK 11.3 and Swift 5.4. Reversible if Xcode is installed later.
Desktop latency of 0.5-2s per step is accepted and is stated in the PRD so the product cannot promise browser speed for desktop work.

notes: Gate cleared 2026-09-20. prd, arch and plan approved by the owner; build unblocked. T2 is now in progress.
